papers.title: Synthetic Kernel A
papers.source_text:
--- Page 1 ---

Method
Kernel A stores a bounded queue and discards the oldest entry when the queue is full.

Experiments
On Dataset X with batch size 1, metric latency is 12 ms on CPU Y.

Limitations
Kernel A cannot preserve entries after a process restart.

papers.title: Synthetic Kernel B
papers.abstract: Kernel B stores entries on disk and recovers them after a process restart. Its throughput depends on disk speed.
